html:
A railway tunnel through the Alps in Switzerland, opened in June 2016. At about 57 km it is the longest rail tunnel in the world.

The Gotthard Pass has been a main route between northern Europe and Italy since the Middle Ages. The first Gotthard rail tunnel opened in 1882, high up and reached by steep, winding lines. The base tunnel runs near the foot of the mountains, so trains travel almost flat and can be longer, heavier and faster.

Swiss voters approved the project in the 1990s, partly to move freight lorries off Alpine roads and onto rail. With the Ceneri Base Tunnel further south, it forms a flat rail route through the Alps on the axis from Rotterdam to Genoa. The old pass route, once crossed on foot and by mule, now takes under 20 minutes by train.
sum: A railway tunnel through the Alps in Switzerland, opened in June 2016. At about 57 km it is the longest rail tunnel in the world.
